findings.title: Paid-booking early return skips workflow-reminder cancellation
findings.body: In handleCancelBooking.ts the paid-booking branch refunds, updates status to REJECTED and returns at req.statusCode = 200 before reaching the workflow-reminder cancellation block at line 485. A cancelled paid booking therefore never marks email reminders cancelled nor cancels/deletes SMS reminders, so scheduled SendGrid/Twilio reminders for that booking will still be sent.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but leaves WorkflowReminder row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true does the SendGrid POST cancel and then returns without deleting or marking the WorkflowReminder row. Callers for reschedule and workflow/step delete rely on this to clean up the old booking, so the DB row stays scheduled=true forever (until the past-date sweeper deletes it). It is an orphan leak and inconsistent with the SMS path which deletes the row.

findings.title: One SendGrid failure aborts all pending email cancellations
findings.body: The cron loops remindersToCancel with await client.request inside a single try/catch. If any batch_id is null, already sent, or SendGrid errors, the exception jumps to the catch, skips Promise.all for already-queued deletes and skips all remaining reminders. One bad reminder therefore prevents cancellation of all later reminders, so cancelled/rescheduled emails will still be sent.

findings.title: Past-due sweep deletes DB rows without cancelling SendGrid
findings.body: The handler first does deleteMany where scheduledDate <= now for EMAIL reminders without calling SendGrid cancel. A reminder marked cancelled=true whose scheduledDate passes before the 1-hour cancel window runs (cron downtime, delay, or clock skew) will be deleted from the database but the SendGrid scheduled send remains live, so the email for a cancelled/rescheduled booking will still be delivered.

findings.title: Reschedule reminder cancellations are fire-and-forget
findings.body: originalRescheduledBooking.workflowReminders.forEach calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting. The surrounding try/catch cannot catch async rejections and the handler continues to reschedule and return. Cancellations may not complete, fail silently, or race with new reminder creation, leaving old reminders to still send.

findings.title: Cancel-booking reminder cancellations are not awaited
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach with nested workflowReminders.forEach invokes async deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting or collecting promises. Failures are unobserved and the API can return success before SendGrid/Twilio cancellation or the cancelled=true update has happened, making cancellation unreliable under load or on process exit.
